headline: Strip Him
caption:
UPDATE: Nassourdine Imavov just offered Sean Strickland $500K of his own money to fight him. 💰
Take it or skip it? 👇

The UFC middleweight contender says the champ is "just scared" if he still says no, and wants the UFC to strip him. Strickland reportedly passed on UFC 335 over pay; Imavov wants the title fight in January. UFC news.

Does Strickland take the money?
question: Take it or skip it?
